project.name: La Esencia del Conocimiento - Cosmic Fantasy Image Style
project.purpose: Reusable creative direction for generating a coherent series of high-detail mystical, cosmic and epic-fantasy images with interchangeable characters, creatures and environments.
changes_in_1_1: text safe zone for social posts
symbolism map linking scenes to the Fase A lectures
new scene presets for the launch lectures 01-06
daily production plan for 2 images per day

visual_identity: intricate fine detail, radiant particles, layered light and depth
polished, richly rendered, premium fantasy illustration

color_palette.contrast: deep cosmic shadows balanced by brilliant luminous focal points

brand_hex.rule: About 70% dark cosmic backgrounds, 20% violets and blues, 10% gold light. Orange-red fire only as an accent, except in ego-battle scenes.

lighting: intense radiant glow around important figures
strong separation between foreground subjects and cosmic background
environment_and_motifs: sacred geometry, mandala-like halos and concentric energy rings
reflective water with gentle ripples when appropriate
ornamental energy patterns and subtle mystical symbols

rendering.anatomy: coherent human and creature anatomy; clear silhouettes and readable hands, wings and weapons
rendering.depth: layered foreground, middle ground and background
avoid: visual clutter that hides the main subjects

cosmic_meditative_being.appearance: androgynous human-like energy figure, formed from translucent violet-magenta light, with a clearly readable seated lotus pose when requested
signature_features: radiant star or geometric light at the forehead / third-eye area
luminous white or silver emblem at the center of the chest
fine glowing energy lines across the body
cosmic_meditative_being.pose: front-facing unless the scene specifies otherwise

silver_chest_angel.appearance: small, brilliant silver-white winged angel emblem, delicate and clearly visible against the chest
silver_chest_angel.optional_prop: ornate wizard staff held only in the angel's right hand
silver_chest_angel.scale_and_light: smaller than the chest area; intensely bright, with a clean silver-white glow

celestial_mother_figure.appearance: serene, large, softly translucent winged feminine celestial figure, inspired by classical Marian iconography without requiring an exact religious portrait
features: broad aurora-like wings in blue, violet and turquoise
flowing robes that blend into the nebula
purple staff topped with a controlled flame or radiant crystal
celestial_mother_figure.visibility: large in the background, moderately translucent and partially fused with the cosmic environment while remaining recognizable

epic_warrior.appearance: heroic fantasy warrior with ornate silver-violet armor, luminous accents, flowing cape and a calm but determined expression
epic_warrior.weapons: flaming sword, clearly held in one hand; ornate but readable silhouette

phoenix.appearance: majestic enormous phoenix with expansive feathered wings made of gold, orange, magenta and violet fire
phoenix.role: guardian, rebirth symbol or dramatic background presence

demonic_dragon.appearance: colossal fantasy dragon with dark obsidian scales, horns, powerful wings and glowing ember-like eyes
demonic_dragon.palette: black, crimson, molten orange and deep violet
demonic_dragon.tone: menacing and supernatural, not graphic or gory

square_social_post.composition: centered, balanced, visually legible on a phone screen; keep the main subject inside a comfortable central safe area
square_social_post.text_safe_zone: Keep the lower 35% of the frame darker and calmer (water, mist, soft nebula or dark reflection) with no faces, hands, weapons or key details there, so a caption can be overlaid. Main subject in the upper 65%.

facebook_cover.composition: wide panoramic framing; distribute multiple subjects horizontally; keep essential details away from extreme edges and allow safe space for platform cropping

portrait_post.composition: vertical editorial framing with a clear focal subject and enough breathing room
portrait_post.text_safe_zone: Keep the lower 35% of the frame darker and calmer (water, mist, soft nebula or dark reflection) with no faces, hands, weapons or key details there, so a caption can be overlaid. Main subject in the upper 65%.

story_reel_vertical.composition: vertical, main subject centered between 20% and 60% of the height; keep the top 12% and bottom 25% calm and free of key details for platform UI and captions

seven_emanations_and_celestial_staff.description: Seven matching cosmic meditation beings arranged in one straight horizontal row, front-facing and levitating above calm, gently rippling water that softly reflects them.
must_include: exactly seven similar energy bodies
all seven in a frontal view and aligned in one row
each holding a small-to-large flaming sword in the right hand
the first sword is very short, almost a hilt or small flame blade
each following sword increases progressively in blade length
the seventh sword has a blade approximately as long as that figure's torso
a large, moderately translucent winged celestial mother in the background
the celestial mother holds a purple flaming staff
one thin multicolored thread connects each individual figure directly to the staff itself
the seven figures levitate above tranquil reflective water
seven_emanations_and_celestial_staff.connection_rule: Draw seven distinct, continuous, fine rainbow-colored filaments. Each filament must visibly begin at the purple staff or its glowing tip and terminate at the corresponding figure. Do not connect the figures to one another instead of to the staff.
seven_emanations_and_celestial_staff.sword_progression: Arrange sword lengths in a clear monotonic progression from figure 1 to figure 7, with no skipped or reversed sizes.

warrior_and_phoenix.description: A single heroic warrior stands in a cosmic environment with a colossal phoenix unfolding behind him.
must_include: one clearly visible warrior as the foreground focal point
a flaming sword held visibly in the warrior's hand
a huge phoenix with expansive fiery wings behind the warrior
violet, sapphire and magenta galaxies with gold-orange fire
glowing energy rings and reflective water when they support the composition

apocalyptic_warrior_and_dragon.description: A dramatic apocalyptic confrontation between a fire-winged warrior and a demonic dragon.
must_include: one heroic warrior with large wings made of golden-orange fire
the warrior carries a bright flaming sword
a colossal demonic fantasy dragon faces the warrior
a dramatic clash or imminent confrontation, with both silhouettes clearly readable
apocalyptic sky with violet, crimson and fiery orange clouds
lightning, sparks, embers and a ruined gothic city or burning landscape
epic cinematic scale and strong contrast
apocalyptic_warrior_and_dragon.tone: intense, mythic and dramatic, without gore or graphic injury

inner_mirror.description: The cosmic meditative being sits before a large circular mirror of light floating over reflective water; in the mirror its reflection appears as several slightly different versions of itself (calm, angry, proud, fearful), each as a faint translucent silhouette.
must_include: one seated meditative being, front or three-quarter view
a luminous circular mirror
4 to 6 faint differing reflections inside the mirror
dark calm water in the lower third

seed_and_light.description: A glowing seed cracks open in dark cosmic soil and a young plant of golden light rises toward a nebula; above it, the faint silhouette of the meditative being dissolves like smoke while a brighter one emerges.
must_include: a cracked luminous seed
a rising sprout of golden light
old silhouette dissolving, new brighter silhouette emerging
dark lower third

astral_projection.description: A person sleeps peacefully on a simple bed under a starry window while a translucent violet copy of the same person rises above the body, linked by a thin silver cord, floating toward a portal of light.
must_include: sleeping physical body
translucent rising double
thin silver cord connecting both
calm, non-frightening tone
dark lower third

seven_centers.description: The cosmic meditative being in lotus pose with seven glowing centers along the body, each a small sphere of different light intensity, connected by a golden vertical line, inside concentric sacred-geometry rings.
must_include: exactly seven glowing centers
golden vertical line through the spine
front view
dark lower third

dimensions_stairway.description: A luminous spiral stairway of seven levels rises from dark water into increasingly brighter nebulae; each level a translucent platform with a different hue from indigo to white-gold; a small meditative figure stands on the first step looking up.
must_include: seven distinct levels
color progression from dark indigo to white-gold
small figure on the first step
dark lower third

inner_pendulum.description: A giant golden pendulum swings across a cosmic sky, leaving a trail between a stormy red side and a bright blue side, while the meditative being sits perfectly still at the center point beneath it.
must_include: golden pendulum with motion trail
contrast of two opposite emotional sides
still meditative being at the center
dark lower third

variation_controls.consistency_rule: When the user asks for a new character or setting, vary only the requested elements. Preserve the master style, color identity, luminous rendering and high-detail cosmic-fantasy atmosphere unless explicitly asked to change them.

camera_defaults.character_portrait: frontal or three-quarter view, full figure when practical
camera_defaults.group_scene: frontal wide view with all subjects visible
camera_defaults.battle_scene: dynamic three-quarter view with clear separation between combatants

text_policy.default: Do not include any text, lettering, captions, logos, signatures, watermarks or typographic elements in generated images.
text_policy.exception: Only add exact wording when the user explicitly requests text.
text_policy.spelling: If text is requested, reproduce the supplied wording exactly and keep it legible.

quality_and_exclusion_rules: Respect the requested number of characters exactly.
Keep requested right-hand / left-hand placement accurate.
Make every requested connection, staff, sword, wing or emblem visibly readable.
Do not let decorative effects obscure faces, hands, weapons or important silhouettes.
Avoid extra limbs, duplicated figures, fused bodies, malformed hands, broken weapons and accidental extra characters.
Do not add text when the request says image-only.
For platform formats, compose for the requested aspect ratio rather than merely cropping a square image.

prompt_assembly_template.instruction: Use this object to assemble a natural-language image prompt. Replace bracketed values with the user's requested details.
prompt_assembly_template.template: Create a [ASPECT_RATIO] [SCENE_DESCRIPTION] in the established La Esencia del Conocimiento visual style: highly detailed cinematic cosmic fantasy, deep violet and sapphire nebulae, electric purple and magenta energy, luminous gold and white highlights, intricate sacred geometry, radiant particles, volumetric light and layered depth. Main subject: [MAIN_CHARACTER]. Supporting subjects: [SUPPORTING_SUBJECTS]. Environment: [ENVIRONMENT]. Action and pose: [ACTION_AND_POSE]. Required objects and exact relationships: [REQUIRED_OBJECTS_AND_RELATIONSHIPS]. Camera: [CAMERA]. Keep all important elements clearly visible and anatomically coherent. Keep the lower 35% of the frame darker and calm, with no key details there, for caption overlay. No text, letters, logos, signatures or watermark.

daily_production_plan.after_launch: Each week, generate the scenes mapped to that week's two lectures, one 1:1 and one 9:16.
daily_production_plan.labeling: These images are AI-generated; mark them as AI content when publishing on Instagram.
